title: Harrow: Echo Shard on Wretched Vapors vs Leech Therapy
question: Which imbue target gives more value from Echo Shard's reset?
hypothesis: Vapors: Echo resets ~20s (25s T1 x0.8 Superior Cooldown) for a second rush on another teammate; Leech: resets ~16s for 4 more leeches that add no stacks once at 18. Prediction: damage prevented on teammates per 60s fight is >=25% higher with Echo on Vapors; Leech arm deals <15% more damage.
controls: Cooldowns, HP, leech stacks reset between trials
Same boons/souls/ability points in both arms except the item/imbue under test
Same enemy hero, level, items, behaviour
procedure: 60s fight vs 2 enemy bots focusing allies
Cast imbued ability on cooldown, use Echo as soon as ready
Record ally damage taken, specters healed off, enemy damage dealt

metrics.name: ally_damage_taken_60s
metrics.how: sum of ally HP lost (damage log)

decision.rule: SUPPORTS echo_vapors if ally damage taken >=10% lower with non-overlapping ranges
